name: The Grand Suites at Four Seasons Macau
positioning: All-suite, residence-style Four Seasons property adjoining Four Seasons Hotel Macao on the Cotai Strip
best_for: Families and groups wanting spacious suites on the Cotai Strip
Travelers who want a suite with a fully equipped kitchen

facts.text: The Grand Suites at Four Seasons adjoins its sister hotel, Four Seasons Hotel Macao.
The hotel is at the heart of the Cotai Strip.
The hotel is within walking distance of top casinos, shopping outlets and dining options.
The hotel is a 15-minute drive to Macau's historic centre.
Macau International Airport is 5 minutes by car.
The accommodations are five Grand Suites types: Dynasty, Imperial, Taipan, Skyview Suite and Skyview Villa.
The Dynasty Suite measures 163–259 m2 (1,755–2,788 sq. ft.).
Vista 38 serves Chinese and Western specialties.
The In-Suite Dining menu is available 24 hours.
Guests of The Grand Suites have complete access to The Spa at Four Seasons Hotel Macao.
Zi Yat Heen is a Michelin-starred Chinese restaurant at Four Seasons Hotel Macao.

highlights.text: A heated outdoor pool with cabanas is exclusive for guests staying at The Grand Suites.
Guests can be chauffeured in a Rolls-Royce Phantom VIII.
In-suite shopping services bring the Shoppes at Four Seasons experience directly to guests.
Select suites have private fitness rooms.
Guests are welcomed to their suite with a personalized tea ceremony.

considerations.text: Limousine transportation from the airport to the hotel carries fees.
The complimentary shuttle-van from the Macau Taipa Ferry Terminal is first-come, first-served.
WhataHotel notes the casino environment may not suit all travelers.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
